title: The subfields K_J of the fraction field of k[[x]][y] cut out by a p-basis
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number, $k$ a field of characteristic $p$ and $(t_i)_{i\in I}$ a $p$-basis of $k$: the monomials $t^E=\prod_it_i^{e_i}$ ($0\le e_i<p$, almost all $e_i=0$) form a basis of $k$ over its subfield $k^p=\{a^p:a\in k\}$. Let $n,m\ge0$ and $A=k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]][y_1,\ldots,y_m]$, the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] in $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ over the formal power series ring $k[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]; it is an integral domain, and let $K$ be its fraction field, $K^p=\{a^p:a\in K\}$. For a finite subset $J\subseteq I$ let $k_J\subseteq k$ be the subfield generated by $k^p$ and the $t_i$ with $i\in I\setminus J$, let $A_J=k_J[[x_1^p,\ldots,x_n^p]][y_1^p,\ldots,y_m^p]\subseteq A$ be the subring of polynomials in $y_1^p,\ldots,y_m^p$ whose coefficients are power series $\sum_Ea_Ex_1^{pe_1}\cdots x_n^{pe_n}$ with all $a_E\in k_J$, and let $K_J\subseteq K$ be the fraction field of $A_J$ (the set of quotients $a/b$, $a,b\in A_J$, $b\ne0$). Then: (1) for every finite $J\subseteq I$, $A$ is a finitely generated $A_J$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; (2) $K^p\subseteq K_J$ for every finite $J$; (3) $K^p=\bigcap_JK_J$, the intersection over all finite subsets $J\subseteq I$; (4) for finite $J,J'\subseteq I$ we have $K_{J\cup J'}\subseteq K_J\cap K_{J'}$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07P5 (lemma-power-series-ring-subfields, line 11521) and its proof; properties (2)-(4) are conditions (1)-(3) of Lemma Tag 07P4 (lemma-intersection-subfields), written out; tags verified in stacks-project/tags/tags
